description: TypeScript: two independent features in one Change Set (CSV export of orders on the server, a dark theme on the client), so the Walkthrough should have two Chapters.

intent.goal: Add a CSV export of orders, and a dark theme.
requirements: Admins can download orders as CSV
Users can switch between a light and a dark theme

domainChanges: Orders can be downloaded as a CSV file
Users can switch to a dark theme, remembered between visits
